outgoing.name: 16th century
outgoing.excerpt: The galley slave sequence is anachronistic: in reality, galley slaves did not exist until the 16th century.

outgoing.name: Jerusalem
outgoing.excerpt: Judah Ben-Hur is a rich Jewish prince and merchant in Jerusalem at the beginning of the 1st century.

outgoing.name: Jesus
outgoing.excerpt: He collapses, having lost the will to live, when an as-yet unknown Jesus Christ gives him water and a motivation to survive.

outgoing.name: New York City
outgoing.excerpt: It premiered at Loews Theatre in New York City on November 18, 1959.

outgoing.name: Roman Empire
outgoing.excerpt: Preceding the arrival of a new governor, Judah Ben-Hur's childhood friend Messala arrives as military commanding officer of the Roman legions.

outgoing.name: Sermon on the Mount
outgoing.excerpt: After Judah sees his mother and sister in the leper colony, Judah's love interest Esther witnesses the Sermon on the Mount.
